The problem

Marketing is the job that waits until you have time, so it never happens.

Most small businesses do no online marketing at all. Not because they don’t want to, but because every option costs more than they have. The work itself has never been offered. Until now.

Do it yourself

Three to four hours a day you don’t have, spent on captions, Canva files and calendars instead of the business.

Buy tools

A scheduler, a design app and a chatbot cost about ₹4,000 a month, and it still leaves every post for you to write, design and publish.

Hire someone

An agency starts at ₹20,000 a month. A junior marketing hire costs ₹31,400. Both still need managing every single week.

Frequently asked questions.

Contact support
What is Sahoda?

Sahoda is an AI-powered marketing employee that helps businesses plan, create, and manage their marketing from one place.

How does Sahoda work?

Sahoda learns about your business, creates marketing content, plans campaigns, and helps automate your marketing workflow.

Do I need marketing or technical skills to use Sahoda?

No. Sahoda is designed for business owners who want to simplify marketing without needing technical expertise.

Can I review content before it gets published?

Yes. You stay in control by reviewing and approving content before it goes live.

Who can use Sahoda?

Sahoda is built for small and growing businesses that want to save time, maintain consistent marketing, and grow their online presence.
